crossRefs.note: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor about what they strongly affirm.

people.name: Job
people.line: A righteous man who endured great suffering

translations.web: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
translations.bsb: I paid you full attention. But no one proved Job wrong; not one of you rebutted his arguments.
translations.kjv: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
translations.asv: Yea, I attended unto you, And, behold, there was none that convinced Job, Or that answered his words, among you.
